title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: declarative agents with actions in GCC High and DoD
summary: Hold: the briefing says Microsoft documents no automation for User access, but Learn documents preview Tenant Configuration Management automation for that setting. That automation is global-service only, so the absence must be narrowed to the government clouds rather than asserted generally. The roadmap facts, cited control paths and explicitly reported disagreements about cloud support are supported.
